findings.claim: The Ghostty scrollback encoder omitted the OSC 8 content bit while the viewport encoder set it.
findings.evidence: With the bit disabled and WASM rebuilt from source, the real-WASM linked-scrollback test received undefined; restoring the bit rebuilt green.

findings.claim: Renderer setup destroyed scroll geometry during resize, letting the browser clamp the anchored offset to zero before render.
findings.evidence: Removing pending offset preservation changed the regression from expected 600 to received 0; the fixed path passes one resize, coalesced resizes, five isolated E2E repetitions, and 14/14 full serial E2E.
findings.layer: browser DOM lifecycle and scroll anchoring
findings.path: WTerm.resize -> Renderer.setup -> scheduled render -> scrollTop restoration

findings.claim: Ghostty hyperlink metadata cache is not pruned with scrollback rollover.
